name: 状態列の見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate ONE compact Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0005 状態列の見出し.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL image1 controls icon geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing and small control anatomy. Japanese mock image2 is SECONDARY for Japanese text/layout; do not copy rough dotted text substitutes or its over-separated count. Image3 is official white surfaces/restraint only, not bus content.
A single small horizontal kanban column header: thin empty neutral circular statusicon; Japanese「未着手」; count「2 / 3」placed close after the label as ORIGINAL; flexible space; tiny three round dots horizontal ellipsis action; small thin plus action. Match ORIGINAL icon weight and optical sizes, all aligned. No enclosing button circles behind plus/ellipsis, no invented chevron, no green filledstatus or check.
Meiryo Regular14/24 Japanese body, Regular12/16 count, zero tracking at320x48 logicalpixels. Count lighter gray, label #1D1D1D, utilityglyphs #526173. Keep everything compact, balanced and notbold. All white #FFFFFF canvas/header; no broadgray/mint panels, no extra cardwrapper, only extremely subtle neutral separation if needed.
No primary filledaction or meaningful categoryaccent is present: remain neutral. Do not invent a green gradient button. Exact visible text only「未着手」「2 / 3」. No heading, other rows, metrics, explanatorycopy or English. Tight standalone component framing, minimal outerwhitespace. Static design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 全原画像・切抜き・通常/390幅モックを実見。未着手、2/3、空状態円、実際の三点/追加を確認。原画像に従い件数を見出し近傍へまとめ、余分な色を加えずスレート補助と白面を採用。文字切れ・内容欠落無し。生成キャンバス余白があり、厳密な書体/線幅同一性の証明ではない。エージェント目視確認のみで所有者承認・編集可能化・動作実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
